extraction_method.name: RUST SYNTHASE
extraction_method.description: Each section is a protein. The synthase reads the DNA (monolith), transcribes to mRNA (module), and the ribosome (browser) assembles the protein (running code).
steps: 2. Extract each section into a .js module file
3. Module exports a function that receives (ctx, cx, cy, R, breathT, ...globals)
4. index.html becomes the ribosome: loads modules, passes context, calls render
5. Each module = one organ = one drop-and-move point
6. We control it because we are now inside AND outside
extraction_method.result: index.html goes from 5,614 lines to ~800 lines (the skeleton/ribosome). Organs live in js/ as separate files.

what_stays: Canvas setup, render loop (tick), event handlers, module loader, the skeleton
what_moves: Every section that draws, senses, or processes — the organs
